title: 2026年云计算新格局：AI‑原生服务、无服务器容器融合与中美安全合规竞争加速
core_insight: 全球云平台正加速AI‑原生、无服务器与容器化融合，同时在安全合规与实时数据分析竞争中出现显著的中美双向结构性转型。

dimension_texts.technology: AWS推出Amazon ECS Gateway和Lambda Web Functions，实现全托管容器入口和原生无服务器Web框架；Google Cloud发布Agentic Data Cloud、AI.AGG和Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash，深化AI‑native与Serverless融合；Azure在Foundry Agent Service中预览Microsoft Copilot，展示AI代理与云原生服务的深度结合。 AWS Continuum提供AI驱动的代码漏洞检测，S3 Tables支持Hive到Apache Iceberg迁移；Google AlloyDB for PostgreSQL新增直接Iceberg访问，Compute Engine API实现多版本化；Azure引入硬件审计日志的Cloud HSM并发布管理开放权重模型风险的指南，提升安全可审计性。 Announcing AWS Lambda Web Functions Introducing Amazon ECS Gateway: A fully-managed ingress solution for ECS services AWS Continuum for code vulnerabilities is now generally available Building an agent skill optimizer with AlphaEvolve, Harbor and Gemini 4 Argon Semantic aggregation over millions of rows in BigQuery with AI.AGG Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast, cost-effective, and reliable video generation and editing now generally available Designing Azure silicon on Azure silicon: EDA workloads on Cobalt 200 Managing open-weight model risk in enterprise deployments
